token_grid: devagents.evals.calibrate.grid(token_base): input_scale x {0.75, 1, 1.25}, reasoning_tokens x {0.5, 1, 2}, extra WORK steps per agent {0, 1}; 18 points
prior: uniform over the members of each reveal set

power.gated_variant: both, each at its own best allocation: deliberation (one high-effort checkpoint per general event of the plan run: t0, the reveal, each child's termination; postmortem section 8 requires high-effort checkpoints in calls per run) and presentation (the other follow-up stage B can select)
power.allocation_rule: per mechanism, the allocation with the highest search power (ties: fewer runs); G9 uses a fresh final estimate at that allocation

decision: INDETERMINATE if G1 (integrity) fails, or if the evaluation cannot complete before a G2-G8 FAIL is logged (evaluation_progress); an abort after a logged G2-G8 FAIL with G1 passing is FAIL; otherwise PASS if every criterion G2-G5 and G7-G9 passes, else FAIL

comparators.router: per cell, the best fixed-structure plan of the library in expectation over the reveal set
comparators.generic_workflow: per regime, the best of every W0 pipeline and every one-line rule (one feature of n_units, n_catalog_docs, cand_read_s, n_needed, needed_read_s, max_needed_s; one global midpoint threshold; post-reveal features choose only between triage-first pipelines) by mean fitness over every template world of that regime; a t0 feature may separate the templates, so a one-line rule may act as a per-template switch: it is not excluded, because excluding it would restrict the baseline's information (GATE_0_SPEC.md section 2.1)
disclosed_not_gated: typed one-line rules (fitted per template and regime)

expectation_not_a_criterion: recorded before any candidate evaluation: each template's oracle policy is a one-line contingent rule (A: fan out iff the revealed reading is long and time is urgent; B: speculate and release the units the memo rules out, which is the W0 pipeline W:spec<k>+dissolve), so W* can reproduce one template's value exactly and G3/G4 is expected to FAIL by construction; G9's deliberation variant is expected to fail because one high-effort checkpoint costs about 0.147 fitness (urgent) against effects of about 0.05
